notes.title: patch 1.6.2 - achievements fixed
notes.content:
Hey all,

I just sent out a quick patch for the game. Steam achievements weren't getting triggered before, but that has now been fixed. 

I hope everyone is managing the best they can during this pandemic, and I'm sorry for the frustration I'm sure the achievement issue caused. 

I appreciate people's understanding. I'm a solo developer doing this in my spare time, and unfortunately I can't keep track of the community hub as much as I'd like.

If you guys have any other issues, or questions, feel free to contact me via e-mail; I'm much more likely to actually see your messages that way!

gamesbylum@gmail.com

Thanks,
lum

notes.title: Version 1.6 available
notes.content:
Hi all,

It's been a while... but I'm back with a few bug fixes.

[list]
[*]Fixed bug where you wouldn't be able to get a new heart from watering flowers
[*]Fixed UI scaling so that it no longer appears super tiny when on higher resolutions
[*]*Potentially* fixed bug where an important final sequence in the 'Mansion' would not appear. (This bug has been difficult to reproduce on my end)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi all,

Just wanted to let you all know that I just uploaded a patch which addresses some bugs, and also makes a couple changes to the difficulty of the game.

Here's whats new:

[list]
[*] The Devil difficulty ramping changed. There is now an additional "state" the Devil can enter, [spoiler]where it will fire 2 fireballs. The Devil will still fire 3 fireballs after a certain number of days however.[/spoiler]
[*] Timing between fireballs adjusted so there is more time for players to dodge (at later days)
[*] Bug where the Gamepad + Audio settings would change when you tabbed out of the game now fixed. In general, these settings work better than they did before.
[*] Game will automatically pause if you tab out of the game
[*] Fixed bug that involved pausing the game
[*] After completing the game, and continuing your save, you will start with full stamina so you don't accidentally start a new day
[/list]

And that's it! I realize that there were a few more bugs that people had mentioned in the community hub, but after hours of testing, I've been having a hard time replicating them. I've attempted to fix up code that [i]should[/i] fix certain bugs, but unfortunately I can't be certain the bugs are actually fixed.

That all being said, please let me know in the community hub if you run into anymore issues!

-lum
